tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Bidder should have an average annual turnover of at least Rs.5Crores during each of the last 3 financial years of 2022-23, 2023-24& 2024-25

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have an average annual turnover of at least Rs.5Crores during each of the last 3 financial years of 2022-23, 2023-24& 2024-25

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The Bengaluru North University will examine an overall readiness for the project. Obtaining the Certificate of Capability Assessment from Authority is a mandatory requirement, and it must be uploaded along with the bid document on the e-Procurement portal.
The bidder and OEM should not have been Black listed by any with Central Government, State Governments or any Government or PSUs or Banks.
The bidder shall conduct a survey of the documents and records available at the University that are proposed to be scanned and digitized.

The bidder shall demonstrate the process of scanning and digitization of records and files, including the methodology, equipment, software, and quality-control procedures proposed for the work. within 30.09.2025.
The Bidder should be an established firm/organization in Scanning or Digitalization or Modernization Projects as on date of publishing of RFP.
The Bidder should be registered as a company in India as per The Company Act1956 OR Partnership Act 1932 and should have been in operation for a period of at least 12 Years.
The bidder should furnish the information on Scanning or Digitalization or Modernization Projects in the past three years
The Bidder should have an average annual turnover of at least Rs.5Crores during each of the last 3 financial years of 2022-23, 2023-24& 2024-25
The Bidder should have had an average net worth of at least Rs.1.5Crores during the last 3 financial years of2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
The bidder should not have been blacklisted by the Central Government, State Governments or any Government organization/agency in India/orPSUs or Banks.

The Tenderer must possess the requisite equipment to execute the project immediately. This includes owning at least 20 Units A2 and A4 Scanners of requisite quality and capacity, with proof of ownership invoices and Serial Numbers required for technical evaluation.
